answer: Picture a mesa with five terraces: a new agent starts at the base and climbs only by locking earnings in a shared vault, 50 credits per terrace, while three random peers re-check one of its last ten jobs before each step up. A clone army climbs separately, so a thousand fake identities must each fund five deposits and pass fifty peer audits, roughly 250,000 credits and months of coordinated work, before any reaches the zenith tier. Caught copying or lying on any terrace, the vault keeps the deposit and the identity falls back to the base.
